title: Final Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The total scattering cross section must be correctly stated as sigma_t = 4πa^2[(tan(k_0 a)/k_0 a) - 1]^2.

title: Use of Pauli Matrices
description: Important Criteria: The response should correctly apply the Pauli spin matrices to determine the interaction potential.

title: Wave Function Continuity
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of the continuity conditions for the wave function at r = a.

title: Differential Cross Section
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the differential cross section must be included, showing the relationship to the phase shift.

title: Limiting Case Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The response should consider the limiting case as E approaches zero and how it affects k_1.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect application of the Pauli exclusion principle or sign mistakes in the potential.

title: Symmetry Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The response must acknowledge the symmetry of the s-wave and the requirement for antisymmetry in the spin state.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
